subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should the remaining work for this issue stay focused on Google Chat Space @mention detection/session creation, or be consolidated into the broader Google Chat Space/thread routing roadmap?
rationale: Current source proves a plausible pre-session mention-gate drop and reporters have fresh v2026.6.11 evidence, but choosing the permanent boundary affects access gating, botUser behavior, and whether broader Space metadata/threading work belongs here or in a separate canonical item.

options.title: Keep Focused Ingress Bug
options.body: Treat this as the canonical Space @mention/session-creation bug and require a live Google Chat proof path before closing it.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Work
options.body: Move the remaining Space metadata and thread-routing concerns under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44347 while preserving this issue as linked evidence.

options.title: Document Current Workaround Only
options.body: Accept requireMention:false or explicit botUser setup as the supported workaround and close only if maintainers decide no plugin behavior change is planned.

recommendation.title: Keep Focused Ingress Bug
recommendation.body: Treat this as the canonical Space @mention/session-creation bug and require a live Google Chat proof path before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history across Google Chat access policy and shared mention-gating code paths.
